name: oc-noai-report
description: Companion to oc-time-report that surfaces work reaching test/review/done WITHOUT AI. Same Tempo-worklog data and the same Project + grouped Fix-version filters and five tabs (All, User Stories All, User Stories Final, Bugs Final, Bugs and Others). Scope: tickets whose status is one of In Test / Need sync (after dev) / Ready for Test / Ready for Sprint Review / Done, with ticket-date (resolutiondate, else updated) on or after a cutoff (default 2026-09-01, since AI use before then was negligible). The unit is one ticket x dev area (backend/frontend/qa; overhead excluded): sub-tasks roll up into their parent US, but sub-bugs are kept as their own rows (not rolled under the US), so a ticket worked by two areas counts once per area and % AI is a per-area adoption rate. A unit has AI when it has AI-classified logged time (same rule as the time report: a worklog is AI when its author holds an AI-metrics record on the issue; a US record propagates to its non-bug sub-tasks; a sub-bug uses its own record). Three sections, recomputing live under the filters: Totals by area and Totals by month (Area/Month, total tickets, AI tickets, % AI tickets, logged d, AI logged d, % AI logged), and Details listing only the no-AI units (Ticket, date, Type, Fix version, title, status, Logged d, area, main developer) grouped by area then month. All times in days (1 d = 8 h). Self-contained styled HTML, date-stamped to ./docs/noai-report-<date>-<start>-<end>.html. Shares jira_fetch_dates.py, fetch_tempo_users.py (and the Tempo cache) and the embedded 54-person roster with oc-time-report; only the aggregation differs. Jira via direct REST (mandatory JIRA_API_TOKEN) and Tempo per-user (mandatory TEMPO_API_TOKEN); no Atlassian MCP. Read-only.
